The service restarts only on abort, which is a conservative setting. The unit file does not perform or enable any suspicious actions such as arbitrary code execution, unauthorized network operations, or file system exfiltration. All directives align with standard, secure service configuration practices for a privileged networking daemon.

There are no obfuscated commands, unexpected downloads, or execution of remote code. The file does not modify unrelated system components or exfiltrate data. It also does not invoke shell scripts or use dangerous constructs like eval or curl|bash. As such, this service file presents no evidence of malicious behavior or supply-chain compromise.
</details>
